import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p=params
    E=np.exp(-p[9]*eps)
    base=p[0]+p[1]*T+p[2]*T**2+p[3]*np.sqrt(T)+p[4]*np.cos(T)+p[5]/T+p[6]*np.sin(T)
